cause: The virgin t=0 builder seeds grid_A/clock_A and leaves grid_B/clock_B empty. eligible_sites() intentionally requires simultaneous eligibility in grid_A and grid_B, so the sham canary had zero eligible sites before native buffer synchronization.
fix: C_sham_16 now runs on an explicit synthetic intervention-ready state with the same eligible payload in grid_A and grid_B, then compares BASE vs SHAM for 16 native ticks.
required_execution_policy: Use a NEW clean workdir. Do not resume the failed v1.0.0 workdir because runner SHA/version changed.
